item.title: Dashboard
item.description:
CTI Dashboard

Overview

The project includes Power BI dashboards designed to transform collected Cyber Threat Intelligence data into actionable insights.

The dashboards analyze relationships between campaigns, threat actors, targeted regions and information operations.

Campaign Intelligence

Campaign analysis focuses on identifying attack patterns and targeting trends.

Current visualizations include:

Attack Types per Campaign

Analysis of attack methods associated with tracked campaigns.

Examples:

  • DDoS attacks
  • ransomware activity
  • phishing operations
  • disruptive campaigns

Campaigns per Country

Geographic distribution of tracked cyber campaigns across targeted regions.

item.title: Methodology
item.description:
Methodology

Data Collection

The project is based on publicly available Cyber Threat Intelligence sources.

Information is collected from:

  • security reports
  • government advisories
  • CERT publications
  • threat intelligence research
  • trusted open-source intelligence sources

Data Model

The tracker uses a structured CTI database approach.

Each campaign is analyzed using multiple dimensions:

  • timeline
  • threat actor
  • attack motivation
  • attack type
  • targeted industry
  • targeted region
  • targeted organizations
  • consequences
  • intelligence sources

item.title: Narratives & Information Operations
item.description:
Narratives & Information Operations

Overview

The project tracks narratives and information operations connected with cyber campaigns targeting organizations and critical infrastructure.

The objective is to analyze how cyber activity may be supported by coordinated messaging, influence operations or information campaigns.

Narrative Tracking

Each identified narrative is documented using structured intelligence fields:

  • narrative theme
  • source account
  • date observed
  • language
  • target audience
  • related campaigns
  • supporting sources

Narrative Analysis

The project analyzes:

Narrative Types

Classification of recurring themes and messages observed during information operations.

item.title: Threat Actor Analysis
item.description:
Threat Actor Analysis

Overview

The project tracks threat actors associated with cyber campaigns targeting critical infrastructure and organizations across Central and Eastern Europe.

The objective is to analyze actor profiles, operational activity and relationships between threat actors and campaigns.

Actor Database

Each tracked threat actor is documented using structured intelligence fields:

  • actor name
  • actor type
  • affiliation
  • active period
  • geographic focus
  • associated campaigns
